source_text: Sacerdos edit de sacrificio peccati in loco sancto. Qui peccata populi portat, sanctificatur. Christus esca nostra; peccatum nostrum tulit. Amen.
thought_title: The priest eats the sin offering in the holy place
orientation: Origen is explaining the sin offering, having just spoken of Christ suffering outside the gate and bearing our reproach.
pass_a_gloss: Priest eats from sacrifice of sin in place holy. Who sins of people carries, is sanctified. Christ food our; sin our he carried. Amen.

choices.why: Keeps the genitive literal, matching the Levitical phrase for the sin offering without importing a technical term not in the source.
Passive verb rendered literally to preserve the action of being sanctified rather than a state.
Literal rendering of the predicate nominative, keeping the metaphor of eating Christ as food.
Perfect tense of fero rendered as simple past to match the completed action of Christ bearing sin.

bible_refs.note: Sacerdos edit de sacrificio peccati in loco sancto

pass_b_english: The priest eats the sacrifice of sin in the holy place (Leviticus 6:26). The one who carries the sins of the people is made holy. Christ is our food; he carried our sin. Amen.
